liliana: Dr Liliana is one of the most experienced and well known aesthetic doctors in Scotland. She holds a master level qualification in the field.
Qualified for over 30 years with 15 years NHS experience, she was a partner in a busy Edinburgh GP practice where she developed a special interest in dermatology and minor surgery.
Liliana is passionate about healthy ageing and thinks that her seventh decade will be her best yet!
When not in clinic you'll find her getting involved with interior design projects, improving her balance and flexibility with yoga or seeking some sunshine with friends and family.
Dr Liliana is a member of the General Medical Council, The British College of Aesthetic Medicine and a Fellow of the Royal-Society-of Arts.
becky: Dr Becky is a GP based in Edinburgh with a special interest in skin health and lifestyle medicine. After qualifying as a doctor in 2012 and completing her GP training in 2018, she pursued further expertise in dermatology, earning a distinction in her dermatology diploma.

Following the challenges of working in general practice during COVID, Dr. Becky recognised the limitations of reactive medicine and developed a passion for preventative healthcare. She now focuses on the six pillars of lifestyle medicine, integrating personalised medical advice to support long-term health and well-being.

Becky is married and a mum to two young children. Outside her professional life and motherhood she very much enjoys keeping fit. Her enthusiasm for 'healthy body, healthy mind' has led her to her most recent academic endeavour,  achieving her accreditation in Lifestyle Medicine through the British Society of Lifestyle Medicine.
A member of the General Medical Council
sonia: Dr Sonia is an experienced GP who graduated with commendation from the University of Dundee in 2013. With over a decade of medical practice, she brings a calm, compassionate approach to every consultation.

She has a special interest in skin health and minor surgical procedures, combining clinical precision with an eye for detail. Her passion for dermatology and procedural care led her to complete aesthetic training with Acquisition Aesthetics. She continues to train under the mentorship of Dr Liliana offering safe, natural-looking aesthetic treatments grounded in sound medical practice.

As a mum of three, Dr Sonia understands the challenges of finding time for self-care and values the importance of helping patients look and feel their best. She believes in balance whether in life, health or aesthetics - and this philosophy runs through her practice.
When not in clinic or working at the practice, she enjoys time outdoors, travelling with her young family and finding calm through yoga and cold water therapy.
Dr Sonia member of the General Medical Council
shantini: Dr Shantini is a Consultant Dermatologist and Mohs Surgeon at NHS Lothian, Edinburgh. She has extensive expertise in the diagnosis and surgical treatment of skin cancer, with a specialist focus on facial skin surgery and reconstruction.

In response to growing patient interest, Dr Rice trained in non-surgical aesthetic procedures through the British Cosmetic Dermatology Group and the University of Manchester. Her detailed understanding of facial anatomy, developed through years of surgical experience, underpins her practice in cosmetic dermatology.
She takes a meticulous, evidence-based approach to treatments such as Botox and advanced skincare, with a strong emphasis on natural results, preventative care, and sun-safe strategies.
Outside of work she loves spending time with her children, and she is passionate about gardening and cooking for her family and friends.

Alongside her NHS work leading the skin cancer and skin surgery services, she is an active member of several professional bodies, including the British Cosmetic Dermatology Group, the British Society for Dermatologic Surgery, the British Association of Dermatologists, and she is a Fellow of the Royal College of Physicians of Edinburgh.
suzie: Dr Suzie is an experienced senior clinician and has completed her membership of the Royal College of Emergency Medicine examinations. She has developed a specialist interest in evidence-based preventative medicine, venous health and aesthetics. She has undertaken further training in Longevity Medicine, Ultrasound, Vein Sclerotherapy and Aesthetic injectables.

At Espacio, she draws on her extensive expertise to deliver evidence-based, data-driven preventative healthcare, with a particular focus on weight management and lifestyle medicine to help reduce the risk of chronic disease.

Alongside her preventative health work, she is passionate about helping patients look and feel their best. She provides aesthetic treatments with a gentle, patient-centred approach and has a particular talent for working with nervous or first-time patients, helping them feel comfortable, confident, and at ease throughout their treatment journey.
When not at work, she can be found leading by example; on the netball court, working on her VO2 max, strength or flexibility and spending time with her two children.

natalie: Natalie initially started her career in the beauty industry carrying out skin treatments and building her knowledge of luxury skincare brands. madeleine: With a combination of managerial experience and a background in healthcare, Madeleine joined the Espacio team in early 2026. She has a diverse range of skills developed through a portfolio style career, bringing with her a meticulous eye for detail and a genuine passion for helping with people.

Madeleine first worked for the NHS in a medical role before leaving to start her own environmental business which she successfully managed for three years. She then took up a position within a leading environmental charity and honed her operational management skills further overseeing a busy administration team delivering projects across Scotland.

With a passion for good business and well versed in delivering patient care, Madeleine's focus is on operational efficiency and a seamless patient experience - organising everything in the background so the medical team can just focus on you!
Outwith work you will find Madeleine exploring the Scottish countryside and Lake District with her kids and husband, in the gym dancing along to zumba classes, or out for dinner with her book club.

intro: At Espacio, we believe true confidence comes from feeling your best both inside and out.

Our focus is not on changing who you are, but on supporting you to feel at ease in your own skin. Every treatment is tailored with care and precision, always with your needs and lifestyle in mind. By combining the latest techniques with a thoughtful, personalised approach, we aim to create results that feel natural and empowering.
Our commitment is to help you look and feel your best, in a way that feels authentically you.
difference: At Espacio we appreciate that your individual patient journey is key. We have created a relaxed atmosphere with friendly faces that will get to know you.
An initial in depth consultation is at the heart of everything that we do.
All our practitioners are experienced medical professionals that you can trust.
why: We completely understand the importance of feeling good in your own skin, and how it can affect our confidence in a big way. Our main aim is not to transform you, but to help bring out your best self and give you a boost of confidence.
ethos: We strongly believe in creating a warm and friendly environment that makes everyone feel welcome.  It begins with our dedicated team, we listen with care, encourage open and honest conversations, and are always here to guide you. Ensuring you feel supported and confident throughout your journey with us.
